purpose: independent controlled validation on the manuscript common ResUNet32 backbone; source-network results retained as references, not inserted into common-backbone table
backbone: original benchmark ResUNet32-mid [32,64,128,256], same initial parameterization for all methods
data: same HDF5 domains/train-validation split,256 resolution,integer truncation of fractional labels; no test
selection: earliest maximum foreground micro Dice on first metadata validation sequence block each epoch; final remaining validation blocks

focus.network: common ResUNet32-mid, no extra convolutional parameters, single output; freeze through bridge
focus.replay: first-level features plus hard distilled targets; uniform domain allocation with foreground sampling; alternate new/replay updates
focus.optimizer: SGD lr .01 momentum .99 Nesterov weight decay 3e-5 polynomial .9
focus.encoder: frozen after first task; source train-mode handling retained

cauaug.KD: upstream width-axis sum retained literally; probabilities NCHW
cauaug.teacher: weights frozen; source train-mode BN updates retained
cauaug.evaluation: source-style batch-statistic BN,batch1,CKNet fixed RNG,restore buffers
cauaug.input_adaptation: per-slice minmax [0,1], constant slices to zero; selected before training to satisfy source input range, no test or validation performance used

ted.source_losses: DiceBCE, imageKD, Gaussian SKA, original batch-broadcast AKT/GUGF

limitations: 50epochs/batch4 common among these three, differs from existing conventional150epochs/batch8; disclose method optimizers and computational cost
FOCUS no deep supervision because common backbone has one output; source CCD on three encoder skip levels,first-level replay,encoder incl bridge frozen after task1
FOCUS original HDF5 intensities; CauAug slice-minmax[0,1]; TED slice-minmax clipped [.001,.99]; not source patient-level preprocessing
metadata blocks not verified independent patients;validation repeatedly exposed
failure: within-method pair stops on error; no blind rerun; immutable clock and deadline
artifacts: private rolling checkpoints; publish only self-authored code/protocol and cross-domain/cross-seed aggregates
completion_at_report: All three method pairs completed and validated; scientific success is not inferred from computational completion
